name: @cdr-kit/mcp

tools.name: cdr_discover_vaults
tools.description: Discover Story CDR data vaults (returns each vault's uuid, ipId, creator). Call this first to find a vault to read or subscribe to.

fromBlock.description: Optional start block for the event scan

tools.name: cdr_subscribe_and_access
tools.description: Subscribe to (pay for) a subscription-gated Story CDR vault from the agent's own wallet, then read and decrypt it. Returns the decrypted text. Use when the agent is not yet subscribed.

uuid.description: The vault UUID to subscribe to

periods.description: Number of subscription periods to pay for

maxPricePerPeriodWei.description: Max price per period, in wei, as a decimal string

tools.name: cdr_access_vault
tools.description: Read and decrypt a Story CDR vault the agent is already entitled to (subscribed, or holds the required license). Returns the decrypted text.

accessAuxData.description: Optional 0x-hex aux data (e.g. ABI-encoded license tokenId for tier-gated vaults)

tools.name: cdr_access_license_gated
tools.description: Read and decrypt a license-gated Story CDR vault by presenting a Story license token ID the agent already owns. Encodes the license tokenId as accessAuxData per the deployed LicenseReadCondition.

licenseTokenId.description: Story license token ID (decimal string) the agent holds

tools.name: cdr_get_vault_info
tools.description: Read on-chain metadata for a CDR vault (tokenId, ipId, creator, licenseTermsId). Call this BEFORE subscribing to learn about a vault. View-only, no gas.

tools.name: cdr_creator_vaults
tools.description: List every vault a given creator has minted. Returns uuid + ipId + licenseTermsId per vault. Use to browse one author's catalog.

creator.description: EOA address (0x...) of the vault creator

tools.name: cdr_check_entitlement
tools.description: Check whether an address is currently subscribed to a vault — returns paidUntil unix timestamp + isEntitled bool. Use to avoid paying twice or to decide between subscribe vs access.

subscriber.description: Address to check (default: the agent's own address)

tools.name: cdr_estimate_cost
tools.description: Look up a subscription-gated vault's plan (pricePerPeriod wei, period seconds, payee, mode). View-only. Use to budget before subscribing.

tools.name: cdr_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List all vaults the agent is currently subscribed to (filters recent VaultCreated events by paidUntil > now). Use for budget tracking and renewal decisions.

fromBlock.description: Optional start block for the vault scan

tools.name: cdr_get_fees
tools.description: Fetch the current CDR operation fees (allocate / write / read in wei) and the operational decryption threshold. View-only, no wallet needed.

tools.name: cdr_create_vault
tools.description: Mint an NFT, register the IP, allocate a CDR slot, and configure the read condition — one transaction. Returns the tx hash; read your uuid from the VaultCreated event in the receipt.

readConditionAddr.description: Address of the condition contract for read access

licenseTermsId.description: Story license terms ID (decimal string), if license-gated

valueWei.description: Native value to send in wei (decimal string), default 0

tools.name: cdr_write_vault_data
tools.description: Encrypt a small (<1KB after TDH2 overhead) UTF-8 string and write it to an existing CDR vault. Returns the write tx hash.

dataKey.description: UTF-8 string to encrypt (<1KB after TDH2 overhead)

tools.name: cdr_upload_file
tools.description: Encrypt a file, pin the ciphertext to IPFS, allocate a CDR vault, write the CID+key reference — one composite operation for any >1KB payload. Returns uuid + cid + tx hashes.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file contents (>1KB ok; goes to IPFS)

authHeader.description: Authorization header for the pinning service

tools.name: cdr_create_time_window_vault
tools.description: Create a Story CDR vault gated by an absolute time (or block) window. Read access is only allowed during [startTs, endTs]. Use endTs=0 for 'open-ended after startTs' (release-on-date pattern). Returns the tx hash; read the uuid from the VaultCreated event in the receipt.

startTs.description: Start timestamp (or block) as a decimal string. Use 0 for 'always-on from genesis'.

endTs.description: End timestamp (or block) as a decimal string. Use 0 for 'open-ended after startTs'.

blockBased.description: Interpret startTs/endTs as block numbers instead of unix timestamps

licenseTermsId.description: Story PIL license terms ID (decimal string)

valueWei.description: Native IP to send in wei (decimal). Defaults to 0.

tools.name: cdr_create_dead_man_vault
tools.description: Create a dead-man-switch Story CDR vault. The creator must call cdr_poke_dead_man before each `duration` window elapses, or read access flips to `heirs` (or public). The canonical wallet-recovery / leak-on-disappearance pattern.

duration.description: Heartbeat window in seconds (or blocks) as a decimal string

heirs.description: Heir wallet addresses; allowed to read post-unlock if publicAfterUnlock=false

blockBased.description: Interpret duration as blocks instead of seconds

creatorCanReadWhileLocked.description: Creator can read their own vault pre-unlock

publicAfterUnlock.description: If true, ANYONE reads post-unlock; if false, only `heirs`

tools.name: cdr_create_escrow_vault
tools.description: Create a Story CDR vault released to a buyer only after they pay + confirm delivery. Optional arbiter can refund disputed deals. Seller can also unilaterally claim after `timeoutSecs` of buyer silence.

timeoutSecs.description: Seconds after buyer's pay before seller can unilaterally claim

arbiter.description: Arbiter address; can refund buyer. Omit for no-arbiter mode.

tools.name: cdr_create_multi_sig_vault
tools.description: Create an N-of-M multi-sig Story CDR vault. Read access requires `threshold`-many approvals — either as off-chain EIP-712 sigs collected and submitted at read time (gas-free for signers), or as on-chain `approve()` txs (Safe-style; dashboards read chain). Both paths share the same signer set.

signers.description: Signer wallet addresses (auto-sorted by the helper)

tools.name: cdr_approve_multi_sig
tools.description: Safe-style on-chain approval for a multi-sig CDR vault. The agent's wallet must be one of the configured signers. Once `threshold`-many signers have called approve, anyone can read the vault — no off-chain sig collection needed.

expectedEpoch.description: Optional epoch to bind the approval to. Omit and the agent reads the current epoch from getConfig immediately before sending — safe default. Pass explicitly to fail-fast if a rotation might be racing.

tools.name: cdr_sign_multi_sig_approval
tools.description: Off-chain EIP-712 sign for a multi-sig vault approval. Returns the 65-byte signature; collect threshold-many sigs from different signers and submit via cdr_access_multi_sig.

caller.description: Address that will submit the read tx (sigs bind to caller)

deadline.description: Unix timestamp after which the sig expires (decimal)

tools.name: cdr_access_multi_sig
tools.description: Read a multi-sig vault by submitting threshold-many EIP-712 sigs as accessAuxData. Sigs must be sorted by recovered signer address ascending. Returns the decrypted text.

deadline.description: Deadline the sigs were signed against (must still be future)

sigs.description: 0x-hex sigs, sorted by recovered signer address ascending

tools.name: cdr_rotate_multi_sig_signers
tools.description: Creator-only: swap multi-sig signer set / threshold. Bumps epoch — invalidates BOTH in-flight off-chain sigs AND on-chain approvals from the previous epoch. Use to remove a compromised signer immediately.

tools.name: cdr_poke_dead_man
tools.description: Creator-only: reset the dead-man-switch heartbeat. Bumps unlockAt back to `now + duration`. Cannot poke after the window has lapsed (one-way trapdoor).

tools.name: cdr_pay_escrow
tools.description: Buyer-side step 1: escrow the listing price for a ConditionalEscrow vault. Excess value is refunded same-tx. Returns the pay tx hash.

price.description: Listing price in wei (decimal) — excess refunded automatically

tools.name: cdr_confirm_escrow_delivery
tools.description: Buyer-side step 2: confirm delivery. Releases the escrowed funds to the seller AND grants the buyer read access. Returns the confirm tx hash.

tools.name: cdr_claim_escrow_after_timeout
tools.description: Seller-side: claim escrow funds + grant buyer read access after `timeoutSecs` of buyer silence. Caller must be the configured seller.

buyer.description: Buyer address (the wallet that called pay() on this listing)

tools.name: cdr_refund_escrow
tools.description: Arbiter-side: refund a buyer who paid but disputes delivery. Resets the buyer's paidAt to 0 (they can re-pay later). Caller must be the configured arbiter.

buyer.description: Buyer address (the wallet that called pay() on this listing)

tools.name: cdr_register_ip
tools.description: Register an NFT as a Story IP asset. Fresh-mint mode (spgNftContract → mint a new NFT in that collection and register it). Returns the IP id + tokenId + tx hash.

spgNftContract.description: SPG NFT contract address for fresh mints

recipient.description: NFT recipient address (default: the agent's wallet)

ipMetadataURI.description: Off-chain JSON metadata URI for the IP

nftMetadataURI.description: Off-chain JSON metadata URI for the NFT

tools.name: cdr_attach_license_terms
tools.description: Attach PIL license terms to a Story IP asset. Required before minting license tokens — the terms define the price + downstream rights buyers receive.

ipId.description: IP asset address (0x...) to attach terms to

tools.name: cdr_mint_license_token
tools.description: Mint Story license tokens against an IP asset's licenseTermsId. The minting fee (if any) is paid in WIP per the PIL terms. Buyers use the resulting license token id to unlock license-gated CDR vaults.

licensorIpId.description: Licensor IP address (the seller's IP asset)

amount.description: Number of tokens to mint (decimal string)

maxMintingFee.description: Max minting fee in wei (decimal string)

tools.name: cdr_publish_data
tools.description: Agent-as-publisher one-shot: register a new Story IP + attach commercial PIL terms + create a license-gated CDR vault + write the encrypted secret — in one call. Returns ipId + licenseTermsId + vault uuid + all relevant tx hashes. The highest-value DX win for autonomous data sellers.

dataKey.description: UTF-8 string to encrypt (<1KB after TDH2 overhead) + publish as an IP

spgNftContract.description: SPG NFT contract address (your own — register via SPG factory)

flavor.description: PIL flavor — picks the right preset

defaultMintingFee.description: PIL: default minting fee in wei (decimal string)

tools.name: cdr_register_derivative
tools.description: Register a derivative IP asset — child inherits parents' PIL terms. Pass parentIpIds + licenseTermsIds for the parent-terms mode, OR add licenseTokenIds for the token-mode (mint-and-register).

licenseTokenIds.description: Optional license token ids to consume

tools.name: cdr_register_pil_terms
tools.description: Register standalone PIL license terms (returns licenseTermsId without attaching to a specific IP). Useful when the same terms apply to multiple IPs.

pilTermsJson.description: JSON-stringified PIL terms struct (consult PILFlavor helpers off-tool to build)

tools.name: cdr_wrap_ip
tools.description: Wrap native IP into WIP (Wrapped IP ERC-20). Required before paying royalties through the Story RoyaltyModule.

amountWei.description: Amount of native IP to wrap into WIP (decimal wei)

tools.name: cdr_approve_wip
tools.description: Approve a spender (typically RoyaltyModule) to pull `amountWei` of WIP from the agent's wallet. Pair with cdr_wrap_ip before any royalty-paying operation.
